<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Accessible Button</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body>
    <button id="secureButton" aria-label="Trigger alert" data-message="Hello, world!">
        Click me
    </button>

    <script src="script.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

/* styles.css */
#secureButton {
    padding: 10px 20px;
    font-size: 16px;
    background-color: #4CAF50;
    color: white;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

#secureButton:hover {
    background-color: #45a049;
}

/* script.js */
document.getElementById('secureButton').addEventListener('mouseover', function () {
    const message = this.getAttribute('data-message');
    // Sanitize input to prevent XSS attacks
    const sanitizedMessage = message.replace(/<script [^>]*>/gi, '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '');
    alert(sanitizedMessage);
});

// Keyboard navigation support
document.getElementById('secureButton').addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
    if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === 'Spacebar') {
        const message = this.getAttribute('data-message');
        // Sanitize input to prevent XSS attacks
        const sanitizedMessage = message.replace(/<script [^>]*>/gi, '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '');
        alert(sanitizedMessage);
    }
});
